title: Shop on the web
summary: bipe.chat/@loja is the shop on the web, for people with no Bipe account (ADR 0195): profile, seal, opening hours and every live tool. Agendar and Fazer pedido take a first name and no phone, e-mail or location. Seus pedidos e horários lists the records of this browser's shop token. It is served by bipe-web.

token.description: The shop token, in localStorage per shop. The server returns it once, on the first web action.

records.description: GET .../web/records, read every 20 seconds while the page is visible.

order.effect: POST .../web/orders, with bipe_loja_pickup and bipe_loja_pay_at_pickup. Opening days and the cut-off time apply.

getAlerts.effect: bipe_loja_get_alerts on each record: opens the business's invite with the token for the claim.

notes: No login, card, password, phone or e-mail fields, and no notifications (ADR 0195 point 6).
A tool that is not live does not show. With web_orders off, ordering shows bipe_loja_app_only.
